body:
## Code Review

This pull request introduces a comprehensive, multi-stage deployment and security hardening framework for a Windows Hyper-V runner workstation, including preflight checks, storage pool setup with persistent startup mounting, isolated network configuration with explicit firewall rules, golden image verification, and an unprivileged controller boundary with signed receipt-chain auditing. The review feedback correctly identifies a critical compatibility issue in `Install-ControllerBoundary.ps1` where the `New-Service` cmdlet is called with a `-Description` parameter, which is unsupported in Windows PowerShell 5.1 and will cause installation failures on standard Windows hosts.
